reviews.title: Pretty sweet
reviews.comment: This thing is pretty awesome. Even on the cpu burn test keeps my 9700x at 92 degrees (this cpu does actually run kinda hot, mine does at least). Incredibly quiet. My one worry was that I have trident rgb ram, which is a little higher than its clearance,  but sliding the front fan up a little doesn’t make it less effective and it also doesn’t look goofy in my opinion.
reviews.author: Jeramy Freimuth
